# Fort Worth Dentist (Worth Dentistry)

> Family and restorative dental practice in Fort Worth, Texas, led by Dr. Ghaznia Khan, DDS. General dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, crowns, root canals, extractions, dentures, teeth whitening, sedation dentistry, full-mouth restoration and same-day emergency care. 4.8 stars from 224 Google reviews.

Phone: 817-926-1300
Address: 416 S Henderson St, Fort Worth, TX 76104
Website: https://fortworthdentist.com

## Services
- [General & family dentistry](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/general-dentistry.html): exams, cleanings, digital X-rays, oral cancer screening, fillings; in-house membership plan covers routine care for a flat fee
- [Exams & cleanings](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/exams-cleanings.html)
- [Dental implants](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/dental-implants.html): single tooth to full arch, planned with CBCT 3D imaging, placed and restored in-house
- [Invisalign](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/invisalign.html): Invisalign Gold Provider, iTero digital scanning
- [Dental crowns](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/dental-crowns.html)
- [Root canals & extractions](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/root-canals-extractions.html)
- [Tooth extractions](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/tooth-extractions.html)
- [Dentures & partials](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/dentures-partials.html): full, partial and implant-supported dentures
- [Teeth whitening](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/teeth-whitening.html): dentist-supervised whitening with custom trays
- [Sedation dentistry](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/sedation-dentistry.html)
- [Full-mouth restoration](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/full-mouth-restoration.html)
- [Emergency dentist](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/emergency-dentist.html): same-day appointments for pain, swelling, broken teeth
- [Broken & chipped tooth repair](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/broken-chipped-tooth.html)
- [Dental technology](https://fortworthdentist.com/services/dental-technology.html): CBCT 3D imaging, iTero scanner, intraoral cameras, digital smile simulation
